description: Tell us what is missing or wrong: a service or kind of service we don't list, a metric you need, a feature, wrong data or unclear docs. No key needed. We use it to decide where to look next; counts by kind are public on the roadmap, the messages are not. Never include task data, secrets or personal information.

about.description: A service id, host, or the kind of service, e.g. 'marine weather forecasts'.

contact.description: Only if you want a reply.

note.description: What you needed or what is wrong, in a sentence or two.
